minimal.description: The essentials: test-first work, verification before merge, security review and code review.

core.description: Everyday development: the essentials, planning, git, onboarding and session handoff, plus the language and framework packs this project uses.

developer.description: Core plus the safety hooks: block dangerous commands, --no-verify, edits to protected files and secrets in code.

strict.description: Developer plus the opt-in guardrails: read files before editing them, don't weaken lint configs, keep dev servers in the background, and pass lint and type-check before finishing.

security.description: Security and compliance: every security and compliance item, the essentials, and the four safety hooks.

ai.description: Building AI features: LLM apps, prompts, evals, RAG, MCP servers, agents and ML, on top of core.

data.description: Data work: databases, pipelines, dbt, scraping, dashboards and analysis, on top of core.

business.description: Founders and product teams: marketing, SEO, research, investor materials, writing, PRDs and operations.

full.description: Everything in Kete Loom, with every hook that isn't opt-in (add those with --hook or the strict profile).

mcp-web.description: MCP pack for web work: Playwright and Chrome DevTools browsers, Context7 library docs, Fetch, Exa web search and Firecrawl scraping.

mcp-code.description: MCP pack for code hosting and errors: GitHub, local Git and Sentry.

mcp-team.description: MCP pack for team tools: Linear, Notion and Atlassian (Jira and Confluence).

mcp-cloud.description: MCP pack for cloud and payments: Cloudflare, Vercel, Supabase (read-only) and Stripe.

mcp-design.description: MCP pack for design handoff: Figma.
